correctness.rationale: In the stated positive component-rate, column-vector setting all three maps on first-state mass have slope exp(−(s+t)h). Their fixed points lie on the line from p_A=b/s to p_B=d/t at parameters u_h, 1−v_h and t/(s+t), respectively. Multiplying the affine maps gives the stated hyperbolic-sine ratios; strict sinh convexity places the exact point strictly between the two when p_A≠p_B. Matching fixed points proves the weight, positivity and conditional uniqueness; p_A=p_B makes the generators proportional and both orders exact, and s=t gives a fair choice. For the path, cyclicity gives both traces as tr(exp(hA_3)exp(hB_3)); the two rate-one edge generators are −2 times rank-one orthogonal projections with squared overlap 1/4. At z=exp(−h) the product trace is 3−2(1−z²)+(1−z²)²/4, while the sum has eigenvalues 0,−1,−3. Their difference is (1−z)^4/4 for all h>0, excluding even real affine mixtures. These analytic checks, not the supplied sampled verifier (inspected, not executed), establish the claims. The result concerns one-step transition matrices, not pathwise equality.
